newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps may raise Loewen Group.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps may raise Loewen Group.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it may raise the double-B-plus ratings on the senior guaranteed notes of Loewen Group Inc and Loewen Group International Inc.
Duff said it may also raise the double-B-minus rating on Loewen's convertible first preferred shares series C and Loewen Group Capital's Monthly Income Preferred Securities.
A total of approximately $830 million of debt and preferred securities were affected by the rating account.
Duff said it put the debt and securities on "rating watch-up" after Service Corp International made an unsolicited bid for Loewen.

"The combined entity would become by far the largest publicly onwed funeral service and cemetery company in North America," Duff said in a report. "Further, the combined company is expected to be less leveraged and generate better cash flow coverage ratios compared with Loewen on a stand-alone basis."
Duff said it downgraded Loewen's ratings as a result of increased concern that new common equity issues will be deferred, the proceeds of which would support an aggressive acquisition program.
